scripts.//test: Runs only the 'default' vitest project (see vitest.config.ts). The 'gci' project is on-demand (needs a live stone) and is excluded here on purpose; run it with `npm run test:gci`. Without --project, vitest would run both projects.
scripts.//test:coverage: Line/branch coverage for the default project, v8 provider. Takes a path prefix to scope the report, e.g. `npm run test:coverage --workspace client -- src/undo`; with no argument it reports on everything the suite loaded. The whole suite runs either way — a file is only reported as uncovered if no test anywhere exercised it.
